blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Police have arrested one of the suspects behind the killing of a Department of Education (DepEd) supervisor last April in Alicia, Zamboanga Sibugay. The suspect was apprehended by virtue of a warrant of arrest for murder in an operation conducted by personnel of the 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company under the Zamboanga Sibugay Police Provincial Office (ZSBPPO) on Monday, Oct. 5. Colonel Barnard Dannie Dasugo, ZSBPPO provincial director, said the arrest was a major breakthrough in the killing of DepEd supervisor Rey Camaingkig.
